_comment: Evidence for every coverage element rated 'None' (no public data) in answer_coverage_service.py.
Each claim lists the Data.gov searches run (SSA datasets with downloads) and every hit a person
reviewed, with why it does not close the gap. scripts/check_gap_claims.py re-runs the searches
and fails on any new, unreviewed hit. tests/test_catalog_grounding.py requires an entry here
for every 'None' element and fails when searched_on is older than max_age_days.

Race and ethnicity data.verdict: No SSA dataset with downloads on Data.gov reports disability applications, decisions or beneficiaries by race or ethnicity.

Travel distance to nearest SSA field off.verdict: No SSA dataset with downloads on Data.gov reports distance or travel time to field offices.

Field office service area boundaries.verdict: No SSA dataset with downloads on Data.gov defines field office service areas.

Accessibility accommodations at field of.verdict: No SSA dataset with downloads on Data.gov describes physical accessibility or accommodations at field offices. The only related record is national interpreter call counts (US-GOV-SSA-2318).

reviewed_hits.US-GOV-SSA-2318: National Telephone Interpreter Service call counts (2018 on) — shows language-service use, not per-office physical accessibility or accommodations.

Reasons for claim denials.verdict: No SSA dataset with downloads on Data.gov reports why disability claims are denied (medical vs. technical reasons).

reviewed_hits.US-GOV-SSA-1409: Processing-time dataset; mentions technical denials only as an exclusion — no denial reasons.
